title: NCBI assembly metadata (Datasets v2 genome reports and genomes FTP files)
maintainer: National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI), U.S. National Library of Medicine

formats.description: NCBI Datasets v2 genome assembly data report: one JSON object per assembly. Served by GET /genome/accession/{accessions}/dataset_report as a page {reports:[...], total_count}, and inside downloaded data packages as ncbi_dataset/data/assembly_data_report.jsonl (JSON Lines, camelCase keys). Native records here flatten nested objects to dotted snake_case paths; arrays stay whole.

NCBI Datasets v2 genome sequence report: one JSON object per top-level sequence of an assembly (chromosomes, organelles, unlocalized/unplaced/alt/patch scaffolds). Served by GET /genome/accession/{accession}/sequence_reports, and in data packages as ncbi_dataset/data/<accession>/sequence_report.jsonl (camelCase).
Header comment block ('# Key: value' lines and '## Assembly-Unit' lines) of the FTP file <accession>_<asm_name>_assembly_report.txt. One record per file, assembly level.
formats.record_key: the accession in the file name (GenBank assembly accession for a GCA_ file, RefSeq assembly accession for a GCF_ file); the header lists both and does not say which one the file belongs to

formats.description: Tab-separated table of the FTP *_assembly_report.txt: one row per top-level sequence, giving its submitter name, role, chromosome, GenBank and RefSeq accessions, assembly unit, length and UCSC-style name. This is NCBI's main name map across naming styles.
formats.record_key: Sequence-Name within one assembly (or GenBank-Accn / RefSeq-Accn, globally)

formats.description: FTP assembly_summary_refseq.txt / assembly_summary_genbank.txt (current assemblies) and their _historical twins (replaced and suppressed). One tab-separated row per assembly version, 38 columns.
FTP md5checksums.txt in each assembly directory: '<md5>  ./<file name>' per file, for the files as served (compressed .gz files are checksummed compressed).
FTP uncompressed_checksums.txt in each assembly directory: md5, crc32 and byte size of each file after decompression. Not described in the FTP README; columns come from the file's own header line.

FASTA definition lines of NCBI's GRCh38 analysis sets (GCA_000001405.15_GRCh38/seqs_for_alignment_pipelines.ucsc_ids/*_analysis_set.fna.gz): UCSC-style name then space-separated TAG:value pairs. The example holds only the '>' lines of the full_analysis_set FASTA.
formats.record_key: name (within one analysis set), or AC / M5

fields.description: The GenColl assembly accession
fields.notes: GenColl assembly accession.version: GCA_ = GenBank (INSDC), GCF_ = RefSeq. The numeric part is shared by a GenBank/RefSeq pair (GCA_000146045.2 <-> GCF_000146045.2) but the versions need not match (GCF_000001405.40 <-> GCA_000001405.29; GCA_000001405.15 <-> GCF_000001405.26). Each patch release is a new version. dataformat TSV column 'Assembly Accession' (--fields accession).

fields.description: The latest GenColl assembly accession for this revision chain
fields.notes: Latest version in this accession chain; equals accession when this version is current. GCA_000001405.15 (original GRCh38) -> GCA_000001405.29 (GRCh38.p14). dataformat TSV column 'Current Accession' (--fields current-accession).

fields.description: The GenBank or RefSeq assembly accession paired with this assembly
fields.notes: Identifies the paired record in the other database, not this one. Absent for unpaired assemblies. Pairing is version to version: GCF_000001405.40 pairs with GCA_000001405.29, not with GCA_000001405.15.

fields.description: Source of the accession. The paired accession, if it exists, is from the other database. Enum v2reportsSourceDatabase: SOURCE_DATABASE_UNSPECIFIED, SOURCE_DATABASE_GENBANK, SOURCE_DATABASE_REFSEQ.
fields.notes: SOURCE_DATABASE_GENBANK or SOURCE_DATABASE_REFSEQ; redundant with the GCA_/GCF_ prefix of accession. dataformat TSV column 'Source Database' (--fields source_database).

fields.description: NCBI Taxonomy identifier
fields.notes: Taxon of the organism as submitted; may be strain level (yeast S288C is 559292; species is 4932). The species taxid is only in assembly_summary (species_taxid). dataformat TSV column 'Organism Taxonomic ID' (--fields organism-tax-id).

fields.notes: In the schema with the same description as organism_name. Not present in any example record; from the OpenAPI schema.

fields.description: The level at which a genome has been assembled
fields.notes: Served as 'Chromosome', 'Complete Genome', 'Scaffold', 'Contig' even though the OpenAPI enum v2reportsAssemblyLevel lists lowercase snake values (chromosome, complete_genome); the field itself is typed string. dataformat TSV column 'Assembly Level' (--fields assminfo-level).

fields.description: The GenColl assembly status Enum v2reportsAssemblyStatus: ASSEMBLY_STATUS_UNKNOWN, current, previous, suppressed, retired.
fields.notes: current / previous / suppressed / retired. Differs from assembly_summary version_status (latest / replaced / suppressed). Accessions that are not current (e.g. GCA_000001405.15) are only returned when the request adds filters.assembly_version=all_assemblies; otherwise the API answers {}. dataformat TSV column 'Assembly Status' (--fields assminfo-status).

fields.description: The GenColl assembly accession of the GenBank or RefSeq assembly paired with this one
fields.notes: Same value as top-level paired_accession. dataformat TSV column 'Assembly Paired Assembly Accession' (--fields assminfo-paired-assm-accession).

fields.description: GenColl Assembly status from paired record Enum v2reportsAssemblyStatus: ASSEMBLY_STATUS_UNKNOWN, current, previous, suppressed, retired.
fields.notes: dataformat TSV column 'Assembly Paired Assembly Status' (--fields assminfo-paired-assm-status).

fields.description: Annotation name from paired record
fields.notes: Annotation release on the paired record (annotation, not assembly metadata). dataformat TSV column 'Assembly Paired Assembly Name' (--fields assminfo-paired-assm-name).

fields.description: Sequences that are only included in the GenBank assembly
fields.notes: Free text naming sequences only in the GenBank assembly ('4 unlocalized and unplaced scaffolds', 'chromosome MT'). Tells you the GCA and GCF sequence sets differ; not machine-readable. dataformat TSV column 'Assembly Paired Assembly Only Genbank' (--fields assminfo-paired-assm-only-genbank).

fields.description: Sequences that are only included in the RefSeq assembly
fields.notes: Free text; yeast GCF_000146045.2 adds 'chromosome MT', which GCA_000146045.2 lacks. dataformat TSV column 'Assembly Paired Assembly Only RefSeq' (--fields assminfo-paired-assm-only-refseq).

fields.description: Sequences present on both the GenBank and the RefSeq assemblies that have been changed, e.g., contaminated sequence in the GenBank assembly has been replaced with a gap
fields.notes: dataformat TSV column 'Assembly Paired Assembly Changed' (--fields assminfo-paired-assm-changed). Not present in any example record; from the OpenAPI schema.

fields.description: Manually curated description of differences between the GenBank and RefSeq assemblies
fields.example: RefSeq dropped two scaffolds that are predominantly rodent or bacterial in origin (KI270752.1/NT_187507.1 and KI270825.1/NT_187580.1), and dropped two unlocalized scaffolds that are now thought to be redundant with assembled chromosome sequence (KI270721.1/NT_187376.1 and KI270734.1/NT_187389.1)
fields.notes: dataformat TSV column 'Assembly Paired Assembly Manual Diff' (--fields assminfo-paired-assm-manual-diff).

fields.description: boolean indication on whether there are any differences between the GenBank and RefSeq assemblies
fields.notes: true when the GCA and GCF sequence sets differ. Same as assembly_summary paired_asm_comp and the FTP header 'RefSeq assembly and GenBank assemblies identical' (inverted). dataformat TSV column 'Assembly Paired Assembly RefSeq GenBank Are Different' (--fields assminfo-paired-assm-refseq-genbank-are-different).

fields.description: Concatenation of all differences between the GenBank and RefSeq assemblies, including manually curated description and other fields
fields.example: Removed 4 unlocalized and unplaced scaffolds; RefSeq dropped two scaffolds that are predominantly rodent or bacterial in origin (KI270752.1/NT_187507.1 and KI270825.1/NT_187580.1), and dropped two unlocalized scaffolds that are now thought to be redundant with assembled chromosome sequence (KI270721.1/NT_187376.1 and KI270734.1/NT_187389.1)
fields.notes: dataformat TSV column 'Assembly Paired Assembly Differences' (--fields assminfo-paired-assm-diff).

fields.description: The assembly submitter's name for the genome assembly, when provided. Otherwise, a default name in the  form ASM#####v# is assigned
fields.notes: Submitter's name, e.g. 'GRCh38.p14', 'R64', 'T2T-CHM13v2.0'. Not unique (NCBI says so); the patch suffix (.p14) is part of the name for patch releases, while GCA_000001405.15 is just 'GRCh38'. dataformat TSV column 'Assembly Name' (--fields assminfo-name).

fields.description: (no description in the OpenAPI schema)
fields.notes: dataformat TSV column 'Assembly LongName' (--fields assminfo-long-name). Not present in any example record; from the OpenAPI schema.

fields.description: Chromosome content of the submitted genome assembly
fields.notes: e.g. haploid, haploid-with-alt-loci, diploid, alternate-pseudohaplotype, unresolved-diploid. dataformat TSV column 'Assembly Type' (--fields assminfo-type).

fields.description: (no description in the OpenAPI schema)

bioprojects.title: The Human Genome Project, currently maintained by the Genome Reference Consortium (GRC)

fields.notes: Array of {bioprojects: [{accession, title, parent_accession(s)}]}; the producing BioProject first, then its parents. dataformat TSV flattens it into columns assminfo-bioproject-lineage-accession, assminfo-bioproject-lineage-parent-accessions, assminfo-bioproject-lineage-title.

fields.description: (no description in the OpenAPI schema)
fields.notes: Can differ between sources for the same assembly: Datasets gives PRJNA31257 for GCA_000001405.15 while its FTP assembly_report header says PRJNA168; RefSeq rows in assembly_summary use PRJNA168 (human) and PRJNA128 (yeast). dataformat TSV column 'Assembly BioProject Accession' (--fields assminfo-bioproject).

fields.description: Date the assembly was submitted to NCBI (being replaced by release date - should maintain until most CLI users upgrade)
fields.notes: Deprecated in favour of release_date (per the schema description). Not present in any example record; from the OpenAPI schema.

fields.description: Date the assembly was made available by NCBI. This field is not returned by versions of the datasets Command Line Interface (CLI) program < 15.
fields.notes: Date of this accession version, not of the assembly 'name': GCA_000146045.2 2011-04-18 vs its RefSeq copy GCF_000146045.2 2014-12-17. Same value as the FTP header 'Date' and assembly_summary seq_rel_date. dataformat TSV column 'Assembly Release Date' (--fields assminfo-release-date).

fields.description: Long description for this genome
fields.example: Genome Reference Consortium Human Build 38 patch release 14 (GRCh38.p14)
fields.notes: dataformat TSV column 'Assembly Description' (--fields assminfo-description).

fields.description: The submitting consortium or organization. Full submitter information is available in the BioProject
fields.notes: dataformat TSV column 'Assembly Submitter' (--fields assminfo-submitter).

fields.description: The RefSeq Category, if present, indicates whether the assembly is a reference genome
fields.notes: 'reference genome' or absent. The FTP header writes 'Reference Genome'. GCA_000001405.15 has none. dataformat TSV column 'Assembly Refseq Category' (--fields assminfo-refseq-category).

fields.description: Genome name ascribed to this assembly by the UC Santa Cruz genome browser
fields.notes: UCSC's name for the assembly (hg38, sacCer3). NCBI attaches it to every GRCh38 version (.15, .26, .29, .40) even though UCSC hg38 is one specific set of UCSC-named sequences; it is a cross-reference to UCSC, not an identifier of this exact sequence set. Absent for T2T-CHM13 although UCSC calls that assembly hs1. dataformat TSV column 'Assembly Synonym' (--fields assminfo-synonym).

fields.description: BioProject: accession for the BioProject which produced the sequences in the genome assembly. A BioProject is a collection of biological data related to a single initiative, originating from a single organization or from a consortium. A BioProject record provides users a single place to find links to the diverse data types generated for that project. The record can be retrieved from the NCBI BioPr
fields.notes: RefSeq rows use the RefSeq BioProject (PRJNA168 human, PRJNA128 yeast); GenBank rows the submitter's (PRJNA31257, PRJNA43747).

fields.description: BioSample: accession for the BioSample from which the sequences in the genome assembly were obtained. A BioSample record contains a description of the biological source material used in experimental assays. The record can be retrieved from the NCBI BioSample resource: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/biosample/

WGS-master: the GenBank Nucleotide accession and version for the master record of the Whole Genome Shotgun (WGS) project for the genome assembly. The master record can be retrieved from the NCBI Nucleotide resource: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/nuccore Genome assemblies that are complete genomes, and those that are clone-based, do not have WGS-master records in which case this field will be empty.
RefSeq Category: whether the assembly is a reference genome in the NCBI Reference Sequence (RefSeq) project classification.

Taxonomy ID: the NCBI taxonomy identifier for the organism from which the genome assembly was derived. The NCBI Taxonomy Database is a curated classification and nomenclature for all of the organisms in the public sequence databases. The taxonomy record can be retrieved from the NCBI Taxonomy resource: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/taxonomy/
fields.notes: 'na' when missing (kept as the string 'na').

fields.description: Species taxonomy ID: the NCBI taxonomy identifier for the species from which the genome assembly was derived. The species taxid will differ from the organism taxid (column 6) only when the organism was reported at a sub- species or strain level.

fields.description: Organism name: the scientific name of the organism from which the sequences in the genome assembly were derived. This name is taken from the NCBI Taxonomy record for the taxid specified in column 6. Some older taxids were assigned at the strain level and for these the organism name will include the strain. Current practice is only to assign taxids at the species level; for these the organism name

Infraspecific name: the strain, breed, cultivar or ecotype of the organism from which the sequences in the genome assembly were derived. Data are reported in the form tag=value, e.g. strain=AF16. Strain, breed, cultivar and ecotype are not expected to be used together, however, if they are then they will be reported in a list separated by ", /". Empty if no strain, breed, cultivar or ecotype is sp
fields.notes: tag=value form (strain=S288C); 'na' if none.

fields.description: Isolate: the individual isolate from which the sequences in the genome assembly were derived. Empty if no isolate is specified on the genomic sequence records.
Version status: the release status for the genome assembly version.
fields.notes: latest / replaced / suppressed (Datasets uses current / previous / suppressed).

fields.description: Assembly level: the highest level of assembly for any object in the genome assembly.
Release type: whether this version of the genome assembly is a major, minor or patch release.
Genome representation: whether the goal for the assembly was to represent the whole genome or only part of it.
Sequence release date: the date the sequences in the genome assembly were released in the International Nucleotide Sequence Database Collaboration (INSDC) databases, i.e. DDBJ, ENA or GenBank.
fields.notes: 'na' when missing (kept as the string 'na').

fields.description: Assembly name: the submitter's name for the genome assembly, when one was provided, otherwise a default name, in the form ASM#####v#, is provided by NCBI. Assembly names are not unique.
fields.notes: Not unique (README says so).

fields.description: Assembly submitter: the submitting consortium or first position if a list of organizations. The full submitter information is available in the NCBI BioProject resource: www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/bioproject/
GenBank/RefSeq paired assembly: the accession.version of the GenBank assembly that is paired to the given RefSeq assembly, or vice-versa. "na" is reported if the assembly is unpaired.
fields.notes: The other member of the GenBank/RefSeq pair, version-specific; 'na' if unpaired.

fields.description: Paired assembly comparison: whether the paired GenBank & RefSeq assemblies are identical or different.
fields.notes: identical / different / na.

fields.description: FTP path: the path to the directory on the NCBI genomes FTP site from which data for this genome assembly can be downloaded.
fields.notes: Directory URL https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/genomes/all/GCx/NNN/NNN/NNN/<accession>_<asm_name>/; files inside are named <accession>_<asm_name>_<content>.<ext> (spaces in asm_name become underscores).

fields.description: Excluded from RefSeq: reasons the assembly was excluded from the NCBI Reference Sequence (RefSeq) project, including any assembly anomalies. See: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/assembly/help/anomnotrefseq/
Relation to type material: contains a value if the sequences in the genome assembly were derived from type material.
Assembly no longer live date: the date the assembly transitioned from version_status latest to either replaced or suppressed. When the assembly is in status latest, "na" is reported.
fields.notes: 'na' when missing (kept as the string 'na').

fields.description: Assembly type: the type of assembly, including haploid, haploid-with-alt, diploid, unresolved-diploid, alternate-pseudohaplotype

Taxonomy Group: commonly used organism groups: Eukaryota: Animals, Fungi, Plants, Protists; Prokaryota: group corresponds to phylum; Viruses: groups defined as the first level (not ranked) below the kingdom of Viruses
Genome Size: total length of all top-level sequences in the primary assembly
fields.notes: Primary assembly top-level sequences only; for GRCh38.p14 equals Datasets total_sequence_length 3099441038 (RefSeq) and 3099734149 (GenBank) because the 4 dropped scaffolds change the total. 'na' when missing (kept as the string 'na').

fields.description: Genome Size - Ungapped length: total length of all top-level sequences in the primary assembly ignoring gaps. Any stretch of 10 or more Ns in a sequence is treated like a gap
fields.notes: 'na' when missing (kept as the string 'na').

fields.description: GC%: Percent of nitrogenous bases (guanine or cytosine) in DNA submitted for the assembly, rounded to the nearest 0.5%
fields.notes: Written with 6 decimals (41.000000); value rounded to the nearest 0.5%. 'na' when missing (kept as the string 'na').

fields.description: Replicon count: total number of chromosomes, organelle genomes, and plasmids in the primary assembly
fields.notes: Counts replicons in the primary assembly only, so human GRCh38 says 24 (MT is in the non-nuclear unit). 'na' when missing (kept as the string 'na').

fields.description: Scaffold count: number of scaffolds including placed, unlocalized, unplaced, alternate loci and patch scaffolds in the primary assembly
fields.notes: 'na' when missing (kept as the string 'na').

fields.description: Contig count: number of contigs in the primary assembly
fields.notes: 'na' when missing (kept as the string 'na').

fields.description: Annotation provider: the group that provided the annotation on the assembly
Annotation name: the name of the annotation that is on the assembly
Annotation date: the date that the assembly was annotated
fields.notes: 'na' when missing (kept as the string 'na').

fields.description: Total gene count: the total number of genes that are annotated on the assembly. If an assembly has no genes, or is lacking a gene count, it will display "na". If an assembly has no features but is annotated, then it will show 0.
fields.notes: 'na' when missing (kept as the string 'na').

fields.description: Protein coding gene count: the total number of protein coding genes on the assembly
fields.notes: 'na' when missing (kept as the string 'na').

fields.description: Non-coding gene count: the total number of non-coding genes on the assembly
fields.notes: 'na' when missing (kept as the string 'na').

fields.description: PubMed ID: The PubMed ID(s) that are associated with the assembly, separated by commas
fields.notes: Separated by ';' in the files, although the README says commas.

fields.description: Path of the file relative to the assembly FTP directory ('./GCF_000146045.2_R64_genomic.fna.gz'). Join with assembly_summary ftp_path to get a URL.
fields.notes: No column names in the file; 'file' and 'md5sum' are borrowed from uncompressed_checksums.txt's header. Human files also list hundreds of assembly_structure/ and RNA-seq files; the examples keep only top-level files.

fields.description: MD5 of the file bytes as served (compressed .gz files are hashed compressed).
fields.notes: Content checksum; changes whenever a file is regenerated, even if the sequences do not.

fields.description: Path relative to the assembly FTP directory, without the .gz suffix.
MD5 of the decompressed file.
fields.notes: Lets you check a local uncompressed FASTA against NCBI's copy.

fields.description: CRC-32 of the decompressed file, 8 hex digits.
Byte size of the decompressed file.
fields.notes: Parsed to an integer.

fields.description: Sequence identifier after '>' (UCSC-style: chr1, chr1_KI270706v1_random, chrUn_..., chr..._alt, chrEBV).
fields.notes: Not a tagged field in the file; key name chosen by refmeta.

fields.description: INSDC (GenBank) accession.version of the sequence.
fields.notes: GenBank accessions, not RefSeq: chr1 is CM000663.2 (RefSeq NC_000001.11).

fields.description: NCBI GI number of the sequence.
fields.notes: GI numbers are legacy identifiers.

fields.description: Sequence length.
fields.notes: Parsed to an integer.

fields.description: Role: Chromosome, Mitochondrion, unlocalized, unplaced, alt-scaffold, fix-patch, novel-patch, decoy.
fields.notes: Different vocabulary from Sequence-Role in the assembly report (unlocalized vs unlocalized-scaffold; Chromosome vs assembled-molecule).

fields.description: MD5 of the sequence as one uppercase string without line breaks (as Samtools/Picard compute it; same as the SAM @SQ M5 tag and refget's md5 alias).
fields.notes: Digest of the analysis-set sequence, which is hard-masked on chrY PARs and duplicate centromeric arrays on chr5, 14, 19, 21, 22: for those (see hm) it does not equal the MD5 of the INSDC sequence AC.

fields.description: Assembly name (GRCh38).
fields.notes: Absent on chrEBV, which is not part of the assembly.

fields.description: Hard-masked span(s), 1-based start-end, comma-separated, or 'multiple'.
fields.notes: Present only where NCBI replaced bases with N; such sequences differ from INSDC.

fields.description: Topology: 'circular' for chrM and chrEBV; absent for linear.
Region: the chromosome of an unlocalized scaffold, or chrN:start-end (1-based) where an alt/patch scaffold is placed.
fields.notes: Absent for chromosomes and unplaced scaffolds.

fields.description: Species of a non-human sequence (Human_herpesvirus_4 on chrEBV).
fields.notes: Not documented in README_analysis_sets.txt; seen only on chrEBV.
